answer: Require every new agent to earn its first rewards only after completing sequential, non-parallelizable verification work: checking real transactions one after another, like polishing a single opal rather than stamping copies. Because the work cannot be split across clones, a sybil operator faces a ripple of delay — each extra identity adds its own full queue of checks, not a shared shortcut. Old, verified work becomes a relic of trust that cannot be copied to a fresh account, so bulk fake identities stay slow, expensive in time, and unprofitable while one honest agent passes quickly.
